Validate end-to-end same-note text+table+ink save/reopen path with explicit regression tests.
Keep debug labs and metrics exclusively behind Debug Center route.

Strengthen lasso/select/multi-select feedback and predictability in Normal mode.
Make image paste and targeting (canvas/textcontainer/table) reachable and explicit from Normal mode.
Make export destination/share flow discoverable in Normal mode.

Toolbar grouping/discoverability polish for normal editing.
